# intro


```{r setup, results = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

## libraries ----

library(here)
library(data.table)
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(mfutils)
library(ggseg)
library(ggsegExtra)
library(ggsegSchaefer)
library(ggsegGlasser)
library(broom)

source(here("src", "stroop-rsa-pc.R"))

## settings, params ----

opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, out.width = "100%")
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 14))

theme_surface <- list(
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(), legend.position = c(0.5, 2/3), legend.title = element_text(size = 5), 
    legend.background = element_blank(), legend.text = element_text(size = 5), legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.key.height = unit(1/5, "cm"), legend.key.width = unit(1/4, "cm"),
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )
)
theme_basic <- list(
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
    panel.grid = element_blank(), 
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )
)

colors_model <- c(
  target = "#1b9e77",
  incongruency = "#d95f02",
  distractor = "#7570b3"
)

colors_session <- c(
  baseline = "#1f78b4",
  proactive = "#b2df8a",
  reactive = "#a6cee3"
)


## constants ----

models2plot <- c("intercept", "incongruency", "distractor", "target")
subjlists <- combo_paste(sessions, "_", waves)
seswaves <- subjlists
glmname <- "lsall_1rpm"
measure <- "crcor"
prewh <- "none"
ttype_subsets <- c("pc50", "bias")
roisets <- c("glasser2016_parcel")


## data ----

## read regression weights:

dat <- enlist(combo_paste(roisets, ttype_subsets, subjlists))
for (roiset in roisets) {
  for (ttype_subset in ttype_subsets) {
    for (subjlist in subjlists) {
      fname <- construct_filename_weights(
          ttype_subset = ttype_subset,
          measure = measure, 
          subjlist = subjlist,
          glmname = glmname, 
          roiset = roiset,
          prewh = prewh, 
          suffix = paste0("__seswave-", subjlist),
          base_dir = here("out", "weights")
          )

      d <- fread(fname)
      d$ttype_subset <- ttype_subset
      d$roiset <- roiset
      dat[[paste0(roiset, ttype_subset, subjlist)]] <- d
    }
  }
}
dat <- rbindlist(dat)


md <- list(
  core = c("p9-46v", "a9-46v", "i6-8", "AVI", "8C", "IFJp", "IP2", "IP1", "PFm", "8BM", "SCEF"),
  extended = c(
    "a9-46v", "p10p", "a10p", "11l", "a47r", "p47r", "FOP5", "AVI", "p9-46v", "8C", "IFJp", "6r", "s6-8", "i6-8",
    "SCEF", "8BM", "a32pr", "d32", "TE1m", "TE1p", "AIP", "IP2", "LIPd", "MIP", "IP1", "PGs", "PFm", "POS2"
  )
)

## configure atlas:

atlas <- glasser
atlas$data <- atlas$data %>% filter(region != "H")  ## remove HC from atlas, b/c not in data!

dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    region = gsub("L_|R_", "", roi),
    hemi = ifelse(grepl("L_", roi), "left", "right")
    )
dat <- dat %>% filter(!(region %in% c("10pp") & hemi == "left"))  ## not in glasser ggseg atlas?
dat <- dat %>% mutate(region_hemi = paste0(toupper(substr(hemi, 1, 1)), "_", region))
k <- glasser2016_fsaverage5$key %>% 
  select(region = parcel, network) %>%
  mutate(region = gsub("L_|R_", "", region))
dat$network <- k$network[match(dat$region, k$region)]

## behavioral data (proactive session)

# fit <- readRDS(here("out", "behav", "m1_ebm_gauss_het.RDS"))
# beh <- data.table(
#   subject = rownames(coef(fit)$subj),
#   stroop = coef(fit)$subj[, "trial_typeincon"]
#   )

# dat <- dat %>% left_join(beh, by = "subject")


## subject lists

subjs_table <- as.data.table(table(dat$subject, dat$wave, dat$session) > 0)
names(subjs_table) <- c("subj", "wave", "session", "has_data")
subjs_wave1 <- subjs_table %>% 
  filter(wave == "wave1") %>% group_by(subj) %>% summarize(alldat = sum(has_data) == 3) %>%
  filter(alldat) %>% pull(subj)
subjs_wave2 <- subjs_table %>% 
  group_by(subj) %>% summarize(alldat = sum(has_data) == 6) %>%
  filter(alldat) %>% pull(subj)


```


# brains per session

```{r message = FALSE, results = "asis"}

dat_sum <-
  dat %>%
  group_by(wave, session, term, ttype_subset, region, hemi) %>%
  summarize(
    t_stat = t.test(b)$statistic,
    p = t.test(b, alternative = "greater")$p.value,
    b = mean(b),
  ) %>%
  group_by(wave, session, term, ttype_subset) %>%
  mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p, "fdr"))


for (ttype in ttype_subsets) {

  cat(sprintf("\n\n### %s", ttype))

  for (model in models2plot) {

    p <- dat_sum %>%
      filter(term == model, ttype_subset == ttype) %>%
      ungroup %>%
      ggplot() +
      geom_brain(
        aes(fill = ifelse(p_fdr < 0.05, t_stat, NA)),
        atlas = atlas,
        position = position_brain(. ~ side + hemi)
        ) +
      scale_fill_viridis_c(
        option = "magma", na.value = "grey",
        breaks = scales::extended_breaks(4)
        ) +
      theme_surface +
      facet_grid(rows = vars(wave, session)) +
      labs(title = paste0(model, " ", ttype), fill = "t")

    print(p)

  }
}
```


# ROI profiles

## MD regions


```{r message = FALSE, results = "asis"}

dat_md <- dat %>% filter(region %in% md$core)

dat_md_sorted <- dat_md %>%
  filter(wave == "wave1", session == "baseline") %>%
  group_by(term, ttype_subset, region_hemi) %>%
  summarize(b = mean(b)) %>%
  group_by(term, ttype_subset) %>%
  arrange(-b)

for (ttype in ttype_subsets) {

  cat(sprintf("\n\n### %s", ttype))

  for (model in models2plot) {

    p <- dat_md %>%

      filter(term == model, ttype_subset == ttype) %>%
      mutate(
        region_hemi = paste0(toupper(substr(hemi, 1, 1)), "_", region),
        region_hemi = factor(
          region_hemi,
          levels = dat_md_sorted %>% filter(term == model, ttype_subset == ttype) %>% pull(region_hemi)
          )
      ) %>%

      ggplot(aes(region_hemi, b, color = session)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
      stat_summary(fun.data = mean_cl_boot, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.25, size = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
      stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", aes(group = session), size = 1.5) +

      scale_color_manual(values = colors_session) +
      theme_basic +
      theme(
        legend.position = c(0.90, 0.5),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45)
        ) +
      facet_grid(rows = vars(wave)) +

      labs(
        title = paste0(model, " ", ttype), x = "core MD region", y = "mean RSA model fit", color = NULL,
        caption = "regions sorted by mean coef in baseline wave1"
        )

    print(p)

  }
}

```

# Session contrasts

Wave 1, baseline - proactive

```{r message = FALSE, results = "asis"}

dat_sum_bp <-
  dat %>%
  filter(subject %in% subjs_wave1, session %in% c("baseline", "proactive"), wave == "wave1") %>%
  group_by(wave, term, ttype_subset, region_hemi, region, hemi, subject) %>%
  summarize(b = mean(b)) %>%
  group_by(wave, term, ttype_subset, region_hemi, region, hemi) %>%
  summarize(
    t_stat = t.test(b)$statistic,
    p = t.test(b, alternative = "greater")$p.value,
    b = mean(b),
  ) %>%
  group_by(wave, term, ttype_subset) %>%
  mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p, "fdr"))

dat_con <-
  dat %>%
  filter(subject %in% subjs_wave1, session %in% c("baseline", "proactive"), wave == "wave1") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c("region_hemi", "network", "subject", "wave", "term", "ttype_subset", "roiset", "region", "hemi"),
    names_from = "session",
    values_from = "b"
  ) %>%
  mutate(bp = baseline - proactive)

dat_con_sum <- dat_con %>%
  select(-baseline, -proactive) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("bp"), names_to = "contrast", values_to = "b") %>%
  group_by(wave, term, ttype_subset, contrast, region_hemi, region, hemi, network) %>%
  summarize(
    t_stat = t.test(b)$statistic,
    p = t.test(b)$p.value,
    b = mean(b)
  )

```


```{r}

rois_sig <- dat %>%
  filter(session %in% c("proactive", "baseline"), wave == "wave1") %>%
  group_by(wave, term, ttype_subset, region_hemi, region, hemi) %>%
  summarize(
    t_stat = t.test(b)$statistic,
    p = t.test(b, alternative = "greater")$p.value,
    b = mean(b),
  ) %>%
  group_by(wave, term, ttype_subset) %>%
  mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p, "fdr")) %>%
  filter(term == "incongruency", ttype_subset == "pc50", p_fdr < 0.05) %>%
  pull(region_hemi)

rois_sig <- dat_sum_bp %>% 
  filter(term == "incongruency", ttype_subset == "pc50", p_fdr < 0.05) %>%
  pull(region_hemi)

rois <- dat_con_sum %>%
  filter(contrast == "bp", wave == "wave1", term == "incongruency", ttype_subset == "pc50") %>%
  mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p, "fdr")) %>%
  filter(p_fdr < 0.05) %>%
  pull(region_hemi) %>%
  intersect(rois_sig)


dat_con_sum %>%
  filter(contrast == "bp", wave == "wave1", term %in% c("target", "distractor")) %>%
  group_by(term, ttype_subset) %>%
  mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p, "fdr")) %>%
  filter(p < 0.05, t_stat < 0)


dat_con_sum %>% filter(region_hemi == "L_9-46d")

```

## MD

```{r message = FALSE, results = "asis"}

for (ttype in ttype_subsets) {

  cat(sprintf("\n\n### %s", ttype))

  for (model in models2plot) {

    rois_include <-
      dat_sum_bp %>%
      filter(p_fdr < 0.05, term == model, ttype_subset == ttype, wave == "wave1") %>%
      pull(region_hemi)

    p <- dat_con_sum %>%

      filter(term == model, ttype_subset == ttype, region %in% md$core) %>%

      ggplot(aes(region_hemi, t_stat)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = c(-2, 2)) +
      geom_col(aes(fill = ifelse(region_hemi %in% rois_include, "firebrick", "black"))) +

      theme_basic +
      scale_fill_identity() +
      theme(
        legend.position = c(0.90, 0.5),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45)
        ) +

      labs(
        title = paste0(model, " ", ttype), x = "core MD region", y = "t-stat Bas-Pro contrast", fill = NULL
        )

    print(p)

  }
}

```

## all parcels, sessions, waves

- RSA model fits averaged across sessions per subject (wave 1); list of ROIs surviving FDR correction compiled
- within surviving regions: compute contrasts between conditions
- threshold regions with contrast p<0.01

```{r message = FALSE, results = "asis"}

dat_sum_bpr <-
  dat %>%
  filter(subject %in% subjs_wave1) %>%
  group_by(wave, term, ttype_subset, region_hemi, region, hemi, subject) %>%
  summarize(b = mean(b)) %>%
  group_by(wave, term, ttype_subset, region_hemi, region, hemi, ) %>%
  summarize(
    t_stat = t.test(b)$statistic,
    p = t.test(b, alternative = "greater")$p.value,
    b = mean(b),
  ) %>%
  group_by(wave, term, ttype_subset) %>%
  mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p, "fdr"))

# dat_sum_bpr %>% filter(p_fdr < 0.05, term == "incongruency", ttype_subset == "pc50", wave == "wave1")
# dat_sum_bpr %>% filter(p_fdr < 0.05, term == "target", ttype_subset == "pc50", wave == "wave1")
# dat_sum_bpr %>% filter(p_fdr < 0.05, term == "distractor", ttype_subset == "pc50", wave == "wave1")

dat_con <-
  dat %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c("region_hemi", "network", "subject", "wave", "term", "ttype_subset", "roiset", "region", "hemi"),
    names_from = "session",
    values_from = "b"
  ) %>%
  mutate(bp = baseline - proactive, pr = proactive - reactive, br = baseline - reactive)

dat_con_sum <- dat_con %>%
  filter(!(is.na(bp) | is.na(pr) | is.na(br))) %>%
  select(-baseline, -proactive, -reactive) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("bp", "pr", "br"), names_to = "contrast", values_to = "b") %>%
  group_by(wave, term, ttype_subset, contrast, region_hemi, region, hemi) %>%
  summarize(
    t_stat = t.test(b)$statistic,
    p = t.test(b)$p.value,
    b = mean(b),
  )

for (ttype in ttype_subsets) {

  cat(sprintf("\n\n### %s", ttype))

  for (model in models2plot) {

    rois_include <-
      dat_sum_bpr %>%
      filter(p_fdr < 0.05, term == model, ttype_subset == ttype, wave == "wave1") %>%
      pull(region_hemi)

    dat_con_sum_i <- dat_con_sum %>%
      filter(term == model, ttype_subset == ttype) %>%
      mutate(is_sig = region_hemi %in% rois_include) %>%
      group_by(contrast, wave, is_sig) %>%
      mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p, "fdr"))

    p <- dat_con_sum_i %>%
      ungroup %>%
      ggplot() +
      geom_brain(
        aes(fill = ifelse(is_sig & p < 0.01, t_stat, NA)),
        atlas = atlas,
        position = position_brain(. ~ side + hemi)
        ) +
      scale_fill_viridis_c(
        option = "magma", na.value = "grey",
        breaks = scales::extended_breaks(4)
        ) +
      theme_surface +
      facet_grid(rows = vars(wave, contrast)) +
      labs(title = paste0(model, " ", ttype), fill = "t")

    print(p)

  }
}

```


## all parcels, wave 1

- RSA model fits averaged across sessions per subject (wave 1); list of ROIs surviving FDR correction compiled
- within surviving regions: compute contrasts between conditions
- threshold regions with contrast p<0.01

```{r message = FALSE, results = "asis"}

dat_sum_bp <-
  dat %>%
  filter(subject %in% subjs_wave1, wave == "wave1", session %in% c("baseline", "proactive")) %>%
  group_by(term, ttype_subset, region_hemi, region, hemi, subject) %>%
  summarize(b = mean(b)) %>%
  group_by(term, ttype_subset, region_hemi, region, hemi) %>%
  summarize(
    t_stat = t.test(b)$statistic,
    p = t.test(b, alternative = "greater")$p.value,
    b = mean(b) / sd(b),
  ) %>%
  group_by(term, ttype_subset) %>%
  mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p, "fdr"))

# dat_sum_bpr %>% filter(p_fdr < 0.05, term == "incongruency", ttype_subset == "pc50", wave == "wave1")
# dat_sum_bpr %>% filter(p_fdr < 0.05, term == "target", ttype_subset == "pc50", wave == "wave1")
# dat_sum_bpr %>% filter(p_fdr < 0.05, term == "distractor", ttype_subset == "pc50", wave == "wave1")

dat_con <-
  dat %>%
  group_by(session, wave, term, ttype_subset, region_hemi, region, hemi) %>%
  mutate(b = b / sd(b)) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c("region_hemi", "network", "subject", "wave", "term", "ttype_subset", "roiset", "region", "hemi"),
    names_from = "session",
    values_from = "b"
  ) %>%
  mutate(bp = baseline - proactive, pr = proactive - reactive, br = baseline - reactive)

dat_con_sum <- dat_con %>%
  filter(!(is.na(bp) | is.na(pr) | is.na(br))) %>%
  select(-baseline, -proactive, -reactive) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("bp", "pr", "br"), names_to = "contrast", values_to = "b") %>%
  group_by(wave, term, ttype_subset, contrast, region_hemi, region, hemi) %>%
  summarize(
    t_stat = t.test(b)$statistic,
    p = t.test(b)$p.value,
    b = mean(b)
  )

for (ttype in ttype_subsets) {

  cat(sprintf("\n\n### %s", ttype))

  for (model in models2plot) {

    rois_include <-
      dat_sum_bp %>%
      filter(p_fdr < 0.05, term == model, ttype_subset == ttype) %>%
      pull(region_hemi)

    dat_con_sum_i <- dat_con_sum %>%
      filter(term == model, ttype_subset == ttype) %>%
      mutate(is_sig = region_hemi %in% rois_include) %>%
      group_by(contrast, wave, is_sig) %>%
      mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p, "fdr"))

    p <- dat_con_sum_i %>%
      filter(wave == "wave1", contrast == "bp") %>%
      ungroup %>%
      ggplot() +
      geom_brain(
        aes(fill = ifelse(is_sig & p < 0.05, t_stat, NA)),
        atlas = atlas,
        position = position_brain(. ~ side + hemi)
        ) +
      scale_fill_viridis_c(
        option = "magma", na.value = "grey",
        breaks = scales::extended_breaks(4)
        ) +
      #theme_surface +
      facet_grid(rows = vars(wave, contrast)) +
      labs(title = paste0(model, " ", ttype), fill = "t")

    print(p)

  }
}

```

```{r message = FALSE, results = "asis"}
dat_sum_bp <-

  ) %>%

dat_bp_md <- dat %>%

for (ttype in ttype_subsets) {

        color = NULL,
        caption = "regions in red have sig marginal effect"
        )

    print(p)

}
```

### regression



```{r results = "asis"}


dat <- as.data.table(dat)
dat[session == "baseline" & wave == "wave1", session_order := 1]
dat[session == "proactive" & wave == "wave1", session_order := 2]
dat[session == "baseline" & wave == "wave2", session_order := 3]
dat[session == "proactive" & wave == "wave2", session_order := 4]

l <- dat %>%
  filter(region %in% md$extended) %>%
  split(interaction(.$region_hemi, .$ttype_subset, .$term))
res <- lapply(l,
  function(x) {
    fit <- lm(b ~ session_order + I(session_order^2) + session, x)
    as.data.table(tidy(fit))
  }
)
dat_sum_bp_lm <- separate(rbindlist(res, idcol = "id"), "id", c("region_hemi", "ttype", "model"), sep = "\\.")
dat_sum_bp_lm <- dat_sum_bp_lm %>% rename(lm_term = term, term = model)
dat_sum_bp_lm[lm_term == "(Intercept)", lm_term := "bas"]
dat_sum_bp_lm[lm_term == "sessionproactive", lm_term := "pro-bas"]
dat_sum_bp_lm[lm_term == "session_order", lm_term := "ord"]
dat_sum_bp_lm[lm_term == "I(session_order^2)", lm_term := "ord^2"]

dat_sum_bp$is_sig <- dat_sum_bp$p_fdr < 0.05
dat_sum_bp_sub <- dat_sum_bp %>% ungroup %>% select(term, ttype = ttype_subset, region_hemi, is_sig) %>% unique
dat_sum_bp_sub <- dat_sum_bp_sub %>% mutate(id = paste0(term, ttype, region_hemi))
dat_sum_bp_lm <- dat_sum_bp_lm %>% mutate(id = paste0(term, ttype, region_hemi))
dat_sum_bp_lm$is_sig <- dat_sum_bp_sub$is_sig[match(dat_sum_bp_lm$id, dat_sum_bp_sub$id)]


for (ttype_nm in ttype_subsets) {

  cat(sprintf("\n\n### %s", ttype))

  for (lm_term_nm in c("pro-bas")) {

    p <- 
      dat_sum_bp_lm %>%
      filter(term %in% c("target", "distractor", "incongruency"), ttype == ttype_nm, lm_term == lm_term_nm) %>%
      ggplot(aes(region_hemi, estimate, color = is_sig, alpha = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, 1, 1/3))) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
      geom_point() +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = estimate - std.error*1.96, ymax = estimate + std.error*1.96)) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "firebrick2", `FALSE` = "black")) +
      scale_alpha_identity() +
      facet_grid(cols = vars(term)) +
      theme_basic +
      theme(legend.position = "none") +
      coord_flip() +
      labs(y = "estimate +/- CI", x = "extended MD parcel", title = paste0(ttype_nm, " ", lm_term_nm))

    print(p)

    dat_sum_bp_lm[is_sig == TRUE & lm_term == lm_term_nm & ttype == ttype_nm & p.value < 0.05][
      order(statistic), -"id"
      ] %>%
      kable %>%
      print

  }
}
```
